record.question: He was beaten at his _____________ game. Provide suitable adjective.
record.explanation: Answer D: own. The idiom is “at one’s own game”; own is the possessive adjective that fits. Independent check: The fixed idiom is “at his own game.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
